_help: Copy this file twice: runner_old.json (current setup) and runner_new.json (new setup). Keys that start with _ are notes and are ignored. Never put an API key in this file.
name: old setup (current prompt)
_runner_help: mock = fake answers for testing; recorded = replay saved answers (needs recorded_outputs); client_api = the stub in scripts/runners.py, filled in for this client; or your own file: my_runner.py:run
_model_help: Copy the exact model ID from the client's code or settings (old) or from the provider's deprecations page (new).
_params_help: The same settings the client's code sends. Remove settings the new model rejects.
_system_help: Optional: add a "system" key with the system prompt this setup uses. Without it, the system prompt from each test case is used.
_prompt_template_help: {input} is replaced by the test case input. Example: 'Summarize this ticket:\n\n{input}'
_features_help: Optional. Settings per feature, matched with the "feature" field in the test set. Each feature can have its own "system", "prompt_template", "model" and "params". null removes a setting.
_price_help: From the provider's pricing page, in dollars per 1 million tokens. Used for the cost columns.
_api_key_env_help: The NAME of the environment variable that holds the client's staging key. Not the key itself.
